description: Test source file demonstrating fallback mechanisms for custom tensor types and dispatch keys in PyTorch, including wrapper and mode style tensor type IDs, with associated unit tests.

classes.name: GenericWrapperTensorImpl
classes.description: Custom tensor implementation class that wraps an at::Tensor and provides a TensorImpl interface for custom dispatch key handling.

methods.name: generic_mode_fallback
methods.description: Fallback function for 'mode' style tensor type IDs, increments call count and calls the boxed operator.

methods.name: generic_wrapper_fallback
